node.acceptance_condition: 4–6 items, each with a one-line claim and short accurate description; every uncertain item explicitly flagged; no invented statistics, quotations, exhibitions, or proper names.
node.expected_contribution: The concrete examples and observations that give the final essay texture and credibility.
node.objective: Compile a small stock of 4–6 concrete, accurately described illustrations the essay can draw on, mixing present and past: e.g., the current flood of glossy, symmetrical, sentimental AI 'slop' on social media and stock sites; the recognizable default look of AI imagery; older human-made kitsch such as sentimental calendar and greeting-card art or formulaic academic painting; historical episodes where a new technology (photography, recorded music) was accused of degrading art. For each item give a one-line claim and 2–3 sentences of accurate plain description, and explicitly flag anything you are not confident is true.
node.rationale: A standalone essay for a general reader persuades through vivid, truthful particulars; this child supplies them so the synthesis is not purely abstract.
